value.name: Lucia withholds her secret
value.description: Lucia refuses to reveal anything further, saying she is not ready to tell them yet.

value.name: Lucia denies hiding anything important
value.description: Lucia insists she is not hiding anything that matters and only wants time to think.
evidence: "I'm not — I'm not hiding anything that matters. I just want to think."

value.name: Asha accepts Lucia's answer skeptically
value.description: Asha responds politely but does not believe Lucia's explanation.
evidence: "All right," Asha said again, and meant it, and did not believe her.

value.name: Rosa leads Asha through the house
value.description: Rosa guides Asha upstairs through the old Italianate house, naming the rooms as they go.
evidence: Rosa led Asha up the front stairs slowly, with one hand on the banister, and named the rooms as they passed

value.name: House history is revealed
value.description: The narration establishes the house's layout and the changing use of its rooms, including the dead señor's study, Estela's former bedroom, Daniel's old room, and Lucia's current sleeping room.
evidence: The house was a center-hall Italianate with a double parlor on the first floor, a dining room and butler's pantry and kitchen running along the back, and three stories above.

the señor's study, though the señor had been dead since 1998 and the room was now full of Estela Serrano's correspondence; the front bedroom, which had been Estela's; the back bedroom, which had been Daniel's growing up and was now an unused guest room with a stripped bed; Lucia's old room, where Lucia was currently sleeping, the door closed.

value.name: Asha enters the sewing room
value.description: Asha steps into the sewing room and pauses, taking in the space.
evidence: The sewing room was at the end of the hall, smaller than the others, with a single window that looked out onto a brick wall and a fire escape.

value.name: Sewing room is shown tidy
value.description: The sewing room is revealed to be very tidy, with a black Singer machine on a small table under the window.
evidence: The room was very tidy. A black Singer machine sat on a small table under the window.
